title: Clarinettist Zeb, Buddy Manaday and Edmund Hall after Murray
summary: Zeb was the clarinettist; after Murray left a Covington guitarist, Buddy Manaday, followed, and Edmund Hall later came in on clarinet.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Who were the great clarinetists? Favorites and rivals

blocks.x: Yeah, me, Charny, and George Washington, yeah. I told you a little short fella, I couldn't call his name at the fairs.
Was it before Zeb played clarinet or after?

Zeb was with us too. That was the clarinet player. Zeb, me, Zeb. Yeah, the same band he had. All of a sudden this boy went back and he hired him to play guitar with him. I left and went somewhere. I went away. I never just stayed around much, you know, around the all. Who did he have next?
This boy from where? From Covington.
A fella from Covington. Who's that? Buddy Manaday? Yeah, Buddy. Yeah, that's him.
That's Buddy. Buddy went with him after me. And I guess Edmund Hall came in on clarinet after a while too. Edmund Hall? You don't know him?
Yeah, Edmund Hall. That's right. That's right. Howl Hall would live on Washington Street's brother.
Yeah, that's right. Yeah, that's right. Yeah, he was up north. They got a picture of him with the band. Mm-hmm.
